title: Part 1 Crime Data (Legacy SRS)
description: This dataset represents the location and characteristics of major (Part 1) crime against persons such as homicide, shooting, robbery, aggravated assault etc. within the City of Baltimore. Data is updated weekly. Note: This dataset contains crime data up to 12/31/2024 under the Summary Reporting System (SRS). SRS collected data under a hierarchy rule that reported only the most serious offense in an incident. However, according to data, 10.6% of crimes committed include additional offenses.
